tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: review_pr
tools.description:
Submit one review on an open pull request selected by exact pr_id.

        decision must be approve, request_changes, or comment. body may be omitted
        for approve. request_changes and comment require nonempty body text. The PR
        must already exist and be open. Returns the complete stored review record.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

tools.description: Search the Memanto memory agent by semantic similarity. Use this FIRST before asking the user to repeat information.

Add section:

## Pilot prevention note — Nov 14, 2023

The first concrete prevention case for this first-cut checklist came from a rollup-service validation metrics proposal.

Proposed shape that did not ship:
`rollup_validation_sample_total{validation_result="match|mismatch", replay_source_id="$source_id"}`

Why it failed the checklist:
- `replay_source_id` is a raw replay-stream identifier.
- Cyrus's sample showed the value is effectively unbounded across replay sources, jobs, chunks, and backfills.
- The debugging need was real, but the raw identifier belongs in logs rather than as a metrics label.

Accepted shape:
- Keep raw `replay_source_id` in logs for debugging.
- Use a bounded `source_class` metric label for rollup-service validation dashboards.
- Preserve validation visibility without introducing an unbounded label into the metrics pipeline.

This is evidence that the first-cut Cardinality Guardrails review can prevent a bad label shape without blocking the debugging need. It does not make Cardinality Guardrails mature, complete, or a general telemetry rewrite.", "score": 20}], "count": 50}
